notes.title: V1.13 Update Changelog
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Reduced the consumption of Common Fish and Fine Fish required to craft a Platter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where adjusting screen settings might not take effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound effects for the pet wolf's bark.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.06 is out!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537694/fdda44d3e8d7453cddda54817d61364c06877c63.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Content:[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now hire a second waitress (unlocked at Sushi Shop Level 20), along with new achievements.[/p][/*][*][p]Sushi crafting now grants experience based on sushi quality.[/p][/*][*][p]The total number of each type of fish obtained is now tracked.[/p][/*][*][p]Max-level sushi is now being displayed in the recipe book.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a sound effect for casting the fishing rod.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to automatically launch the game on system startup.[/p][/*][*][p]Max-level aquariums will now automatically feed fish.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Upgrading one fishing rod no longer affects the upgrade cost of others.[/p][/*][*][p]Fisherman behavior has been revamped: he now speeds up automatically when a fish bites, and can also be manually sped up with mouse clicks.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the time it takes for the fisherman to reel in fish.[/p][/*][*][p]Most grid mechanics have been reworked to reduce position clutter.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved swimming animations for aquarium fish.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased coin generation from aquarium fish.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced breeding time for high-quality fish.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the price of the four fish-collecting kittens.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased aquarium satiety depletion rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced late-game aquarium upgrade costs.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced late-game hatchery upgrade costs.[/p][/*][*][p]Clothing store tabs are now displayed as icons instead of text.[/p][/*][*][p]Platter crafting quantity increased from 5 to 8 ; ultimate platter quantity increased from 15 to 30.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased base chance of catching high-quality fish, along with bait effectiveness.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Fish Encyclopedia: fish weight no longer affects completion. Collecting specific weights now unlocks special medals in the encyclopedia.[/p][/*][*][p]Filter and sort options now remember your settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Made it easier to catch strictly herbivorous or carnivorous fish (quality probabilities unchanged).[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the random spawn time range for floating items.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted clickable areas for certain features.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished various in-game texts.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some computers couldn’t save certain data.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected a click offset issue with aquarium decorations when scaled down.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where achievement probabilities failed to sync with Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug causing abnormal fish weight values.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where red notification dots wouldn’t disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented bait from being replenished.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the icon for the Variant Atlantic Salmon.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.03 is out!
notes.notes: [p]VERSION 1.03 Changelog:[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]Adjusted certain art assets for improved visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]The sushi restaurant now refunds uncut fish when canceling orders.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced acceleration when using a keyboard.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the spawn rate of color variants of the Betta fish (non-purple types).[/p][/*][*][p]Floating events now appear less frequently, but offer increased tap rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the resource cost for upgrading fishing rods in the early and mid-game.[/p][/*][*][p]The fry pond is now covered and inaccessible until the hatchery is unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a layering issue in the penguin event.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the black background text from collaboration illustrations.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the sea zone map layout to prevent text overlap.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance when a large number of fish are present.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where boat mode could remain off-screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved clarity of the boat mode icon.[/p][/*][*][p]The aquarium lock button will now correctly save its state.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the size of the gold coin effect for better visual clarity.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Announcing the Release Date for Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi for June 16th!
notes.notes:
To all our cherished players who adore the tranquility of fishing and the charm of leisurely moments,

We are absolutely thrilled to share some incredibly exciting news! Your eagerly awaited idle fishing game, **Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi, is officially launching on [b]June 16th at 7:00 PM (PDT)[/b]**! Are you ready to embark on a delightfully relaxing deep-sea fishing adventure right from the corner of your desktop?

To celebrate the grand debut of *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi*, we are delighted to offer a **[b]10% launch discount for a limited period of 14 days[/b]**! This is a wonderful opportunity to immerse yourself in the joy of fishing under serene blue skies, all at an even more delightful price.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399960/_/

[hr][/hr]

[b]**Exciting Collaborations: Collect Them All!**[/b]
We understand that perhaps just "fishing" isn't quite enough; your desktop deserves a vibrant array of captivating "creatures" and engaging experiences! That's why *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi* will be featuring enchanting collaborations with other beloved idle games. Soon, you'll be able to grab bundled packages, giving you immediate access to multiple desktop idle masterpieces and filling your screen with endless possibilities!

As for which games these are? We'll be revealing them simultaneously on launch day!


What's more, you'll discover familiar faces from other games making special appearances within *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi*! Imagine taking your favorite characters along for a fishing trip! Here's a little whispered preview:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527500/_MiSide/]**MiSide[/url] 
Let's imagine that you have a game in which you care for a character. But could you imagine one day getting into that game yourself?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427700/_Backpack_Battles/]**Backpack Battles[/url]
A PvP inventory management auto battler! Buy and craft powerful items, then carefully arrange them in your backpack.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296610/_Peglin/]**Peglin[/url]
Peglin is a Pachinko Roguelike - Fight enemies by collecting special orbs and popping pegs to deal damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537694/17c43838f68c7ae4aa4990747e584aa71a2a26c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537694/69c6c943acc74c1c2b804cf43d836ad332f4ce18.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]

[b]What's that? You still haven't heard of *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi*?[/b]
In essence, it's a wonderfully relaxing idle fishing game designed to seamlessly blend into your desktop corner. All you need to do is:

[list]
[*] Place it on your desktop** and watch your little fishing boat automatically venture out to sea, returning laden with treasures.
[*] Explore mysterious waters** and reel in all sorts of wonderfully whimsical marine creatures (yes, even rubber duckies!).
[*] Transform your catches** into delectable sushi and serve them to your charming (and perhaps a little peckish) customers.
[*] Upgrade your rods and bait** to hook more rare fish and fill your fish tank to the brim!
[/list]

This game is crafted to offer you a tranquil escape, a moment of "fishing" serenity and satisfaction amidst the hustle and bustle of daily life. Imagine glancing over during a busy workday and discovering you've just reeled in a giant tuna—doesn't that just brighten your day instantly?

Be sure to **add *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi* to your wishlist** so you won't miss our release announcement!

We look forward to seeing you there, as we embark on a new era of desktop tranquility together!

The *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi* Development Team"
